scope: Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y must replay exactly one Change Engine transaction per physical shortcut press
rootCause: RevoGrid 4.25.2 renders multiple revogr-overlay-selection instances. Each instance listens to the same document keydown and emits beforekeydown, so one physical Ctrl+Z could invoke the ERP history handler multiple times.
fix: De-duplicate Revo beforekeydown events by the original browser KeyboardEvent using a WeakSet. One physical key press now triggers at most one Undo/Redo replay.
behavior: Separate cell edits remain separate transactions; Paste remains one transaction when it is enabled in a later gate.
testsAdded: Three separate edits create three Undo transactions
One Undo consumes exactly one transaction
Second Undo consumes exactly the next transaction
